Outcome Difference Model (Ydiff):
 Ydiff ~ cp*1 + b1*M1diff + d1*M1avg + b2*M2diff + b3*M3diff + d2*M2avg + d3*M3avg + Cb1 + Cb2 + Cw1diff + Cw1avg 

Mediator Difference Model (Chained Mediator - M1diff):
M1diff ~ a1*1 + b_2_1*M2diff + d_2_1*M2avg + b_3_1*M3diff + d_3_1*M3avg + Cb1 + Cb2 + Cw1diff + Cw1avg 

Mediator Difference Model (Other Mediators):
M2diff ~ a2*1 + Cb1 + Cb2 + Cw1diff + Cw1avg
M3diff ~ a3*1 + Cb1 + Cb2 + Cw1diff + Cw1avg 

Indirect Effects:
indirect_1 := a1 * b1
indirect_2 := a2 * b2
indirect_2_1 := a2 * b_2_1 * b1
indirect_3 := a3 * b3
indirect_3_1 := a3 * b_3_1 * b1 

Total Indirect Effect:
 total_indirect := indirect_1 + indirect_2 + indirect_2_1 + indirect_3 + indirect_3_1 

Total Effect:
 total_effect := cp + total_indirect

|total_effect     |   -0.741| 0.105| 20000.000| -0.933| -0.522|

Outcome Difference Model (Ydiff):
 Ydiff ~ cp*1 + b1*M1diff + d1*M1avg + b2*M2diff + d2*M2avg + b3*M3diff + d3*M3avg + Cb1 + Cb2 + Cw1diff + Cw1avg 

Mediator Difference Model (Chained Mediator - M1diff):
M1diff ~ a1*1 + b_2_1*M2diff + d_2_1*M2avg + b_3_1*M3diff + d_3_1*M3avg + Cb1 + Cb2 + Cw1diff + Cw1avg 

Mediator Difference Model (Other Mediators):
M2diff ~ a2*1 + Cb1 + Cb2 + Cw1diff + Cw1avg
M3diff ~ a3*1 + Cb1 + Cb2 + Cw1diff + Cw1avg 

Indirect Effects:
indirect_1 := a1 * b1
indirect_2_1 := a2 * b_2_1 * b1
indirect_2 := a2 * b2
indirect_3_1 := a3 * b_3_1 * b1
indirect_3 := a3 * b3 

Total Indirect Effect:
 total_indirect := indirect_1 + indirect_2_1 + indirect_2 + indirect_3_1 + indirect_3 

Total Effect:
 total_effect := cp + total_indirect
